# Veritas Hospitality Advisors

Veritas Hospitality Advisors is India's specialist independent hotel owner advisory firm. Founded by Vaishakh Surendran MIH, Veritas works exclusively for independent hotel and resort owners — reviewing commercial performance, operational governance, and owner reporting. Veritas has no relationship with hotel management companies, brands, or operators.

## Founder

Vaishakh Surendran MIH is the founder and principal advisor. He has 25 years of General Manager experience across India, the Maldives, Kuwait, and the USA, having served under Accor, Wyndham, ITC, and Taj. He was named Best General Manager in Odisha 2024–25 and holds an MIH from Institut Hotelier Cesar Ritz, Switzerland.

## What Veritas Does

- Independent review of hotel commercial performance for owners
- Owner-side oversight of OTA strategy and distribution costs
- Assessment of management reporting and accountability
- Revenue management audit and benchmarking
- Operational governance review
